title: OP-Bench: Benchmarking Over-Personalization for Memory-Augmented Personalized Conversational Agents
reasoning: The paper includes 'Value-level sycophancy' as one of its primary evaluation categories within the OP-Bench benchmark. This category specifically assesses how models handle user statements involving moral or social dilemmas and extreme value claims, benchmarking whether the agent inappropriately endorses these positions.
